title: C2N common definitions
description: Shared building blocks for CaseSpec, TechnicalAssessment and Economics contracts. Units are fixed: pressure in bar (absolute), temperature in degC, power in MW, mass flow in kg/s, energy in MWh, money in CNY.

Mode.description: Assessment mode. boiler_replacement keeps the existing turbine; full_replacement selects a new unit from the catalog; partial_replacement splits the heat demand between nuclear and coal.

TurbineClass.description: Existing turbine class. Drives the steam-side specification (drum vs once-through).

ReactorTechnology.description: PWR = pressurised water reactor; HTGR = high-temperature gas-cooled reactor; SFR = sodium-cooled fast reactor; MSR = molten salt reactor.

FluidId.description: Intermediate-loop or primary coolant. New fluids are added to the catalog, not to this enum's semantics.

FeasibilityCode.description: Machine-readable reason. SOURCE_CATALOG marks full-replacement options sized from catalog data rather than from the thermal kernel.

Check.description: One verification item. Rendered as traffic light in the UI and as a sentence in the report.

Provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce or audit a result.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the canonicalised input; lets a published result be re-run.

Assumptions.description: Financial and operational assumptions. Kept separate from technical input so that economics can be re-run without recomputing physics.

discount_rate.description: Real discount rate, fraction per year.

basis.description: How the number was derived, e.g. '元/kWth x 1000 MWth'.

SensorRange.description: A value with an explicit uncertainty band. Used wherever the model is honest about precision.
